The validated edge is the trend gate for drawdown control (gate_helps true), while cross-sectional rank has weak/insignificant IC so leadership is a focus lens only. Track record has decent hit rate (66%) but near-coin-flip directional accuracy (48%), so convictions stay modest to low.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity ranks #2, is trend-gate eligible, shows the strongest durability_bar (0.85) and full breadth (1.0) among top themes, with a clean 'trend' hurst tag — the combination of the absolute-trend gate plus high durability/breadth supports trend persistence. Crowding flag (z=1.8) is a size-down caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowding z=1.8 is the highest in the table and attention spikes/ETF inflows can mark local tops; the near-perfect breadth may already discount the strong story, leaving little marginal buyer.
